- fixtures/build.tmp: vcs-tracked-content. Git's index tracks it, whatever its name says.
- vms/ext4.vhdx: virtual-disk. An image is never deletable by name; its 64 GiB is a guest disk's capacity, not reclaimable space. Shrinking or removing it belongs to WSL (`wsl --manage`) or the hypervisor.

No approval token was issued and nothing was removed.
